remarks: This updated one-bedroom condominium home has it all, including your own private entrance, an attached garage with interior access, central air and a laundry room located in the lower level of the unit. The generous living room has hardwood flooring and sliders to a private deck. A separate full kitchen sits adjacent to the dining area. The spacious bedroom has a large closet and hardwood flooring. In addition, there is Storage space in the lower level and a reserved parking space. The Eastview condominium complex location is centrally located and convenient to all that Norwalk has to offer. Close to Historic South Norwalk & its restaurants, shopping & Nightlife, the SoNo Collection Mall, museums, Aquarium, Ice Rink & other recreational activities. Easy commute to I95, Merritt Parkway, the Metro North Train Station & Walk to hospital.  Short drive to Calf Pasture Beach and Cranbury Park. This home is a Rare find in Norwalk.  Care Free Living. No Pets please. Unit has 630 sqft on the main floor of living space and 630 sqft in the lower level which consists of garage, laundry room and storage.
